evidence: Frozen task/task.toml:20-24 reads `[environment]` build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096 -- exactly the staged-task-contract.md:56-60 block and the frozen template task.toml:20-24. `diff` of template vs task task.toml shows changes only in [task] name/description/keywords and [metadata] fields (lines 5-15); [agent], [environment], [verifier], [verifier.env], [verifier.environment] are byte-identical to the template. No `docker_image` key and no `allow_internet` key anywhere in task.toml (quality-checks.md:44 requirement). No secret literal under [environment]; the only credential-shaped value in task.toml is task.toml:34 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"` (a ${VAR} template in the frozen verifier block, explicitly allowed by SKILL.md Known false positives) and task.toml:35 `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""`. Agent image task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template Dockerfile (`diff` returned no output): pinned `FROM node:22-bookworm-slim`, no --platform pin, no bare nproc, globally pre-installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 with NODE_PATH set, copies /instructions and /assets, initialises empty /app; no ENV/ARG carrying a secret. Case-insensitive grep of task/environment/** for api_key|secret|token|password|sk-|PRIVATE KEY|AKIA|ghp_|xox|bearer found only hireops_rules.md:11 demo password `Hireops!2026`, which the brief also publishes (instruction.md:17) and SKILL.md lists as an intentional demo credential (not a live secret). cpus=2 / memory_mb=4096 is sane for a Node 22 + Express + better-sqlite3 single-process app plus agent tooling; better-sqlite3 is pre-installed so no native compile is needed at run time. Network posture public is correct per workbook row text and the SKILL delivery profile; not flagged. Counterexample attempts: (a) a weak/broken app cannot exploit this row -- it is static wiring independent of the submission; (b) a conforming alternative could fail only if 2 CPU/4 GB starved a normal build or if an install required network the agent lacked; network is public and dependencies are pre-installed, so neither applies. Conflict recorded, not a defect: the Internal Quality Checks annotation of row 9 says 'Agent image is no-network', contradicting the client-facing row text and the SKILL delivery profile; current profile (public network) governs. Its other clause 'nothing that secretly needs an install' is satisfied because the Dockerfile pre-installs the runtime dependencies and network is public anyway. Measurement note: raw-evidence-index.json contains no agent-image build or agent-resource measurement entry (its entries are scripted golden verifier-image observations); this row is a static configuration check whose subject bytes are identical to the template, so no runtime measurement is required to judge it, and no build/Oracle/model result is claimed here.
